يستعبد (form X)

# يُسْتَعْبَدُ (yustaʕbadu) /jus.taʕ.ba.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# يَسْتَعْبِدَ (yastaʕbida) /jas.taʕ.bi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْبَد
